lessons: CRITICAL fabrication removed: the skill was built on KSP as a third-party-seller platform with a 'partner API for approved vendors' and 'KSP checkout/logistics' -- all FABRICATED. KSP is a first-party electronics retailer with only an affiliate program. Reframed KSP everywhere (description, Step 1/2/3, gotchas, troubleshooting, MCP, platform-guides.md section + comparison table) as a price-comparison reference only, and swapped in Yad2 (Israel's actual dominant marketplace, previously scoped OUT) as a real sell platform. Description change -> Phase 5.7 trigger swap (KSP-sell -> Yad2-sell + invoice triggers), non-regressing.

Added missing core obligations: tax invoice (חשבונית מס/קבלה) per sale, and the Israel-Invoice allocation-number (מספר הקצאה) reform with the dropping thresholds (20k 2025 / 10k Jan 2026 / 5k mid-2026). Added the consumer cancellation-fee cap (5% or NIS 100) and the 4-month extended window (disabilities/seniors/olim). Reconciled the Zap fee contradiction (comparison PPC model vs marketplace commission model). Fixed the stale Instagram URL (business.instagram.com -> facebook.com/business/instagram). Softened the 'Meta removed native checkout in 2025' framing (Israeli Shops never had native checkout -- it was US-only).

Replaced fabricated couriers (Mahirpak/ShipBob IL) with the real Israeli e-commerce couriers (HFD, Cheetah, Baldar) + named Israeli PSPs (Tranzila/Cardcom/Meshulam/Grow) for the off-platform checkout path.

Judge+Expert round 2: the KSP-partner-API fabrication SURVIVED in the HE Recommended-MCP section (and that line still grouped KSP as a marketplace + omitted Yad2) after the EN was fixed -- a fix is not done until BOTH languages match. Fixed HE MCP to mirror EN (Zap store/XML feed + Meta Graph API, no KSP API; Yad2 in the platform list). Also fixed: stale Facebook 'payment processing' line in platform-guides.md, the Zap comparison-table cell (now shows both fee models), and the Bundled-Resources descriptions (KSP->Yad2 in EN+HE).

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): Yad2 is integrated structurally but absent from the worked Examples and the sample analytics report (still Zap/Facebook/Instagram only) -- add a Yad2 example next cycle. Deferred: the research also suggested the skill's category (developer-tools) is a weak fit for an osek-murshe seller persona (marketing-growth / tax-and-finance fit better) and that the Python helper-scripts implied by allowed-tools don't exist -- left both for a deliberate recategorization/scripting decision.
RESOLVED the 1.2.0 deferral: Yad2 is now in Example 1, Example 3 and the Step 6 sample report in both languages.

CRITICAL stale schedule: the Israel-Invoice allocation threshold was written as an uncertain future schedule ('roughly 20k 2025, 10k Jan 2026, 5k mid-2026, confirm before relying'). NIS 5,000 pre-VAT has been in force since 01.06.2026. Now stated flatly with the per-period history, sourced to the Tax Authority announcement gov.il/he/pages/sa311225-1, plus the retroactive-request rule (up to a year, VAT-manager approval past six months) and the fact that it binds B2B only and never an osek patur.

CRITICAL wrong instruction: Step 7 told every registered osek to 'issue a tax invoice (חשבונית מס / קבלה) for every sale'. An osek patur is NOT PERMITTED to issue a חשבונית מס; it issues חשבונית עסקה plus a קבלה. Split the two statuses explicitly. Added the capturable osek-patur ceiling (122,833 for 2026 / 120,000 for 2025) instead of routing to the source, and the three-authority registration point plus אישור ניהול ספרים.

TWO DEAD gov.il URLs that curl could not detect: both /he/ and /en/ service/issuing-allocation-number-for-an-invoice redirect to gov.il/error with HTTP 404. curl returns Cloudflare 403 for BOTH real and nonexistent gov.il pages, so status code is not an oracle on that host; only a browser navigation exposed the 404. Replaced with the live Tax Authority announcement page.

FABRICATION-CLASS removal: 'Zap's store XML feed' was asserted four times (Step 2, Troubleshooting, MCP section, comparison table) as the safe fallback when scraping is blocked. joinzap.aspx contains no occurrence of XML/feed/פיד. Replaced with the ממשק ניהול dashboard that the page does document. Same failure class as the KSP partner-API fabrication removed in 1.2.0.

SELF-INFLICTED, caught by the Judge: this cycle's first edit generalised Zap's storefront requirement to all of Zap and told users to drop Zap if they had no site. joinzap.aspx says the opposite for the marketplace model ('אין צורך שתהיה בבעלותך חנות אינטרנטית'). Zap has TWO models: comparison requires the seller's own site with card clearing, marketplace requires only holding stock. The remediation had reintroduced a defect of the same shape it was fixing.

Phantom fee removed: Step 6 deducted a 'Facebook/Instagram commission' that the skill's own reference file said no longer exists. Also softened to 'confirm current fees in Commerce Manager' rather than asserting Meta charges nothing, which its cited page does not say. Removed the unsupported 'native checkout was always US-only' assertion (three places, both languages) and the unsourced 'September 4, 2025' / 'June 2025' dates; Meta publishes only 'As of September 2025'.

Step 8 was a summary of headlines, not an operator's checklist. Five decision-changing defects fixed: no refund deadline (14 days from the cancellation notice); the 5%/NIS 100 fee presented as always chargeable when it is FORBIDDEN on defect, non-conformity, late delivery or any seller breach; a mandatory-disclosure list missing osek number, address, delivery date/method, offer validity, warranty, manufacturer and country, and the 'no later than delivery' deadline; the 4-month window gated on 'phone or chat' when email and any electronic exchange count, with 65+ now defined; and the homepage cancellation link plus the fact that notice may be oral. Added the up-to-NIS-10,000 statutory damages and the seller-collects rule on breach.

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): second-hand VAT margin treatment. Yad2 is the flagship channel and is a used-goods market, and an osek murshe buying used goods from a private seller is taxed on the margin, not the gross. The Expert flagged it UNCERTAIN and gov.il refused fetching, so no figures were written. Verify against the Tax Authority before encoding.

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): cancellation clocks for services, courses, hospitality and continuing services (different from the goods rule); ongoing post-registration obligations (מקדמות, annual return, NI on business income, monthly vs bi-monthly VAT cadence); the anti-spam consent rule (סעיף 30א) for the outbound buyer messaging Steps 4 and 5 generate; statutory warranty duties for new electrical goods, which Example 2 currently frames as a marketing sweetener.

Deferred (MINOR, third cycle running): category is developer-tools for what is now majority tax and consumer-law content aimed at a non-developer seller. Needs a deliberate recategorisation decision rather than another deferral.
Phase 5.7 not run: the description and trigger surface were unchanged this cycle.
